label: Figma
description: Read design files, components, styles, variables, and comments, render frames as images, and post comments.
securityDescription: Figma sign-in opens through Composio. Agents act as the signed-in Figma user and can read the files, projects, components, styles, variables, and comments that user can open. With write access, Agents can post comments and replies on a file, which everyone who can open the file sees. Agents cannot edit designs or variables, delete comments, manage webhooks or dev resources, or change sharing, team, or billing settings.

capabilities.description: Posts a new comment to a Figma file or branch, optionally replying to an existing root comment (replies cannot be nested); `region_height` and `region_width` in `client_meta` must be positive if defining a comment region.
capabilities.sideEffectLabel: Figma: Add a comment to a file

file_key.description: Figma file key or branch key. Extract from the file URL: https://www.figma.com/design/FILE_KEY/... or https://www.figma.com/file/FILE_KEY/... The FILE_KEY is the alphanumeric string between 'design/' or 'file/' and the next slash. You must have access to the file (editor or commenter permissions required to add comments). For branch keys, use GET /v1/files/:key with branch_data parameter.

comment_id.description: ID of an existing root comment to reply to. Replies cannot be made to other replies.

capabilities.description: Convert design tokens to Tailwind CSS configuration. TWO-STEP WORKFLOW: 1. First, call FIGMA_EXTRACT_DESIGN_TOKENS with a Figma file_key to extract design tokens 2. Then, pass the returned DesignTokens object to this action's 'tokens' parameter This action generates: - tailwind.config.ts/js with theme extensions - Optional globals.css with font imports Note: Shadow colors can be provided in either string format (e.g., "rgba(15, 110, 110, 0.32)") or dictionary format (e.g., {"r": 0.059, "g": 0.431, "b": 0.431, "a": 0.32}).

name.description: The name identifier for the color token.

usage_count.description: Number of times this token appears in the design

sources.description: Count of tokens by extraction source

usage_count.description: Number of times this token appears in the design
Number of times this token appears in the design

total_tokens.description: Total number of design tokens extracted

composio_execution_message.description: Message about execution issues or warnings

tokens.description: Design tokens object obtained from the FIGMA_EXTRACT_DESIGN_TOKENS action output. Contains colors, typography, spacing, border_radius, shadows, total_tokens, and sources.

config_format.description: Output format: 'ts' for TypeScript or 'js' for JavaScript

input.description: Request to convert design tokens to Tailwind config. PREREQUISITE: First call FIGMA_EXTRACT_DESIGN_TOKENS with a Figma file_key to obtain the DesignTokens object, then pass that output as the 'tokens' parameter here.

capabilities.description: Smart Figma resource discovery - extract IDs from any Figma URL. Supports all URL formats: /file/, /design/, /board/, /proto/, /slides/ Example: figma.com/board/ABC123/Name → file_key=ABC123 Discovery workflow: team_id → projects → files → nodes Use extracted IDs with GetFileJson, DetectBackground, etc.

team_id.description: Team ID to list all projects from. Get this from team URL: https://www.figma.com/files/team/YOUR_TEAM_ID/Team-Name. Returns list of projects with IDs and names. Cannot be inferred from user identity or FIGMA_GET_CURRENT_USER; must come from a team URL or be provided directly.

file_key.description: File key to extract all node IDs from. Get this from file URL (figma.com/file/FILE_KEY/...) or from project files list. Returns hierarchical list of all nodes with IDs, names, types, and paths.

figma_url.description: Full Figma URL to extract file_key, node_id, and team_id from. Works with any Figma URL format: • File: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/Design-Name • Design: https://www.figma.com/design/ABC123/Design-Name • Board: https://www.figma.com/board/ABC123/Board-Name • Prototype: https://www.figma.com/proto/ABC123/Prototype-Name • Slides: https://www.figma.com/slides/ABC123/Slide-Name • With node: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/Design?node-id=123:456 • Team:

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth to traverse when discovering nodes. 2=pages+frames, 3=pages+frames+components, etc. Higher values find more nodes but take longer. Responses at depth 4+ or broad file_key traversal can exceed 20k tokens with significant latency; cap at 2–3 and target specific CANVAS or FRAME node IDs to limit response size.

project_id.description: Project ID to list all files from. Get this from project URL or from team projects list. Returns files with keys, names, and thumbnails.

input.description: Request to discover Figma resources and extract IDs automatically.

capabilities.description: Download images from Figma file nodes. Renders specified nodes as images and downloads them. Supports PNG, SVG, JPG, and PDF formats. REQUIRED PARAMETERS: - file_key (string): The Figma file key from the URL - images (array): List of objects, each containing: - node_id (string, required): The node ID to export (e.g., "1:2") - file_name (string, required): Output filename with extension (e.g., "logo.png") - format (string, optional): One of 'png', 'svg', 'jpg', 'pdf'. Defaults to 'png' Example usage: { "file_key": "abc123XYZ", "images": [ {"node_id": "1:2", "file_name": "logo.png", "format": "png"} ] } To find node IDs, use FIGMA_GET_FILE_JSON or look in Figma URLs after 'node-id='. NOTE: Returned image URLs expire shortly after generation — download them immediately.

scale.description: Image scaling factor for PNG/JPG exports (0.01 to 4). Default is 2 for retina quality. Ignored for SVG/PDF. Exports are capped at ~32 megapixels; reduce scale or split large nodes to avoid hitting this limit.

format.description: Image format to export. Supported values: 'png', 'svg', 'jpg', 'pdf'. Defaults to 'png'.

node_id.description: REQUIRED. The Figma node ID to render as an image. Node IDs are found in Figma URLs after 'node-id=' (e.g., '1:2', '123:456'). You can also get node IDs by using the FIGMA_GET_FILE_JSON action.

file_name.description: REQUIRED. The output filename with extension for the downloaded image (e.g., 'logo.png', 'header-image.svg', 'icon.jpg').

items.description: Individual image download request specifying which node to render and how to save it. Example: {"node_id": "1:2", "file_name": "logo.png", "format": "png"}

images.description: REQUIRED. A list of image download requests. Each item must be an object with 'node_id' (string, required), 'file_name' (string, required), and optionally 'format' (string, defaults to 'png'). Example: [{"node_id": "1:2", "file_name": "logo.png"}]

file_key.description: REQUIRED. The Figma file key extracted from a Figma URL. For URL 'https://www.figma.com/file/abc123XYZ/MyDesign', the file_key is 'abc123XYZ'. This identifies which Figma file to download images from.

svg_include_id.description: For SVG exports only: include element IDs in the SVG output. Defaults to false.

svg_outline_text.description: For SVG exports only: convert text to paths for accurate rendering. Defaults to true.

svg_simplify_stroke.description: For SVG exports only: simplify strokes for cleaner SVG output. Defaults to true.

input.description: Request to download images from a Figma file. REQUIRED PARAMETERS: - file_key: The Figma file key (string) - images: List of image download requests (array of objects) Example request: { "file_key": "abc123XYZ", "images": [ {"node_id": "1:2", "file_name": "logo.png", "format": "png"}, {"node_id": "3:4", "file_name": "icon.svg", "format": "svg"} ] }

capabilities.description: Extract design tokens from Figma files by combining styles, variables, and node-extracted values. Only values defined as Figma styles or variables are captured — any design values not encoded as styles/variables are silently omitted. Requires `file_variables:read` scope and a Figma plan that supports variables for full output; if variables return empty, supplement with FIGMA_GET_LOCAL_VARIABLES.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (e.g., 'aA1b2Cd3E4F5g6H7i8J9k0L'). Extract from Figma URLs like figma.com/file/FILE_KEY/... or use FIGMA_DISCOVER_FIGMA_RESOURCES to find file keys

include_variables.description: Include variables in extraction. Even with this enabled, modes and scopes may be incomplete; use FIGMA_GET_LOCAL_VARIABLES for full semantic token coverage including variable modes and aliases.

capabilities.description: Extract prototype interactions and animations from Figma files. Required parameter: - file_key: The Figma file key extracted from a URL like 'https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123xyz/MyFile' (the 'ABC123xyz' part) Analyzes the prototype data to extract: - User interactions (clicks, hovers, etc.) - Transition animations - Component variant states - User flows and navigation

file_key.description: Required. The unique file key from a Figma URL. To find it: from a URL like 'https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123xyz/MyFileName' or 'https://www.figma.com/design/ABC123xyz/MyFileName', extract the alphanumeric string after '/file/' or '/design/' (e.g., 'ABC123xyz'). This is typically 22 alphanumeric characters.

input.description: Request to extract prototype interactions. Note: file_key is required and must be extracted from the Figma file URL.

capabilities.description: Retrieves all comments from an existing Figma file, identified by a valid `file_key`, returning details like content, author, position, and reactions, with an option for Markdown formatted content.

as_md.description: If true, comment content will be returned in Markdown format where applicable (e.g., for links, bold text). Defaults to false, returning rich text structure.

file_key.description: Identifier for the Figma file from which to retrieve comments. This can be a file key (a unique string identifying a file) or a branch key. To obtain a branch key, use the `GET /v1/files/:key` endpoint with the `branch_data` query parameter.

input.description: Request schema for `GetCommentsInAFile` action. Specifies the file and formatting options for retrieving comments.

capabilities.description: Fetches metadata for a specific component using its unique identifier. Use when you need to retrieve published component details from a team library.

key.description: The unique identifier of the component.

input.description: Request schema for retrieving a Figma component by its unique key.

capabilities.description: Retrieves detailed information for the currently authenticated Figma user.

input.description: Request for `GetCurrentUser`; no parameters are needed.

capabilities.description: Retrieves all published component sets from the specified Figma main file (file_key must not be for a branch).

file_key.description: Key of the Figma file. Must be a main file key (not a branch key) as component sets are published from main files. Extract from Figma URL: https://www.figma.com/design/{file_key}/... or https://www.figma.com/file/{file_key}/...

input.description: Request schema for retrieving component sets from a specific Figma file.

capabilities.description: Retrieves published components from a Figma file, which must be a main file (not a branch) acting as a library.

file_key.description: Key of the Figma file. This file must be a main file (not a branch key) that acts as a library, as components are published from main files.

input.description: Request to retrieve published components from a Figma file.

capabilities.description: Get Figma Design file data with automatic simplification. IMPORTANT: Only supports Design files (figma.com/design/{file_key}). FigJam board files (figma.com/board/{file_key}) and Slides files (figma.com/slides/{file_key}) are NOT supported and will return a 400 error: "File type not supported by this endpoint". This enhanced version automatically transforms verbose Figma JSON into clean, AI-friendly format with: - CSS-like property names - Deduplicated variables - Removed empty values - 70%+ size reduction Use simplify=False to get raw API response.

ids.description: Comma-separated node IDs to fetch specific nodes (uses /nodes endpoint). Node IDs can be extracted from Figma URLs: figma.com/design/{file_key}/{name}?node-id={node_id}. Example: '1:2,1:3' for multiple nodes. Must be a string, not an array — passing an array causes validation failure. URL node IDs use hyphens (e.g., '1-2'); convert to colons (e.g., '1:2') before passing here.

depth.description: Tree traversal depth (e.g., 2 for pages and top-level children). Omitting depth on large files can produce extremely large responses or timeouts; scope with `ids` and set depth to the minimum needed.

version.description: Specific version ID; current version if omitted

file_key.description: File key extracted from a Figma Design file URL. SUPPORTED: figma.com/design/{file_key}/... or figma.com/file/{file_key}/... NOT SUPPORTED: FigJam boards (figma.com/board/{file_key}) and Slides (figma.com/slides/{file_key}). Example valid key: 'abc123XYZ' from URL figma.com/design/abc123XYZ/My-Design.

geometry.description: Set to "paths" to include vector data

plugin_data.description: Comma-separated plugin IDs to include plugin data

response_detail.description: Level of detail in the response. 'minimal' (default) simplifies file data for AI consumption. 'full' returns the raw Figma API response.

input.description: Request schema for GetFileJson with simplification options.

capabilities.description: Get Figma file metadata including name, creator, last modification details, thumbnail, and access information. Use when you need quick file overview without the full document tree.

file_key.description: File key to get metadata for. This can be a file key or branch key. Extract from file URL: https://www.figma.com/design/{file_key}/... or https://www.figma.com/file/{file_key}/... Use `GET /v1/files/:key` with the `branch_data` query param to get the branch key.

input.description: Request schema for retrieving metadata of a Figma file.

capabilities.description: Retrieves a list of published styles (like colors, text attributes, effects, and layout grids) from a specified main Figma file (not a branch).

file_key.description: Key of the main Figma file (not a branch) from which to retrieve published styles. Extract the file_key from the Figma URL: figma.com/design/{file_key}/... or figma.com/file/{file_key}/... Note: This endpoint only returns PUBLISHED styles from team libraries. For local/unpublished styles, use FIGMA_GET_FILE_JSON instead.

input.description: Request to retrieve styles from a Figma file.

capabilities.description: Fetches a list of files in a Figma project, optionally including branch metadata.

project_id.description: Identifier of the Figma project, typically found in its URL.

branch_data.description: If true, includes metadata for branches of main files.

input.description: Defines the parameters needed to retrieve a list of files from a specified Figma project.

capabilities.description: Retrieves all local/remote variables for a Figma file/branch; crucial for obtaining mode-specific values which `/v1/files/{file_key}/variables/published` omits.

file_key.description: Key of the Figma file or branch. Can be a standard file key or a branch-specific key (to obtain a branch key, use `GET /v1/files/:key` with the `branch_data` query parameter).

capabilities.description: Retrieves projects within a specified Figma team that are visible to the authenticated user.

team_id.description: Identifier of the Figma team from which to list projects. Note: The `team_id` cannot be programmatically obtained solely from a user token. To find a `team_id`, navigate to a team page you are a member of in Figma. The `team_id` will be present in the URL, typically formatted as `https://www.figma.com/files/team/YOUR_TEAM_ID/Your_Team_Name`.

capabilities.description: Retrieves the version history for a Figma file or branch, as specified by its `file_key`.

after.description: Version ID for pagination; retrieves versions created strictly after this ID.

before.description: Version ID for pagination; retrieves versions created strictly before this ID.

file_key.description: The key of the Figma file or branch from which to retrieve the version history. Extract from file URL: https://www.figma.com/design/{file_key}/... or https://www.figma.com/file/{file_key}/... For branch keys, use `GET /v1/files/:key` with the `branch_data` query param to obtain it. The authenticated user must have access to the file; otherwise a 404 'Not found' error is returned.

page_size.description: Number of version items per page. The API defaults to 30 if this parameter is not sent.

input.description: Request schema for retrieving the version history of a Figma file.
